decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several highly-rated speakers across different price points. The JBL Flip 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_166) was the strongest candidate for its portability and 4.8-star reputation, but the available gray color didn't match my preference and I was specifically hoping for the Flip 6 model's updated features. The Harman Kardon Onyx 6 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) offers superior audio quality but is too bulky for my travel requirements. Budget options like the INSMY (prod_bluetooth_speakers_128) and Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) were tempting, but mixed reviews regarding charging port durability and sound distortion at max volume caused hesitation. Ultimately, none of the current listings perfectly met my needs for price, color, and updated technology, so I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
